_comment: R-AI-01: weights of the computer opponent (stage 4, AI v1). Scores are in MPP; distances in hexes. Tuned by sim ai-vs-ai (GDD section 17).

economy._comment: R-AI-01 п. 3 «экономика» (step 7, designer task 2026-11-27): reinforcements, purchases and boosts valued in expected VP per MPP, greedy; a transfer reserve with two sectors.

pockets._comment: R-AI-01 «поиск котлов» (step 7): chokepoint candidates K, pincers, lookahead phases, supply bands.

defend._comment: Step 7 item 5 «защита своих горловин»: own chokepoints with high D get a reserve when an enemy is near; with no reserve, units the pocket would cut (projected supply ≤ pockets.cut_supply_max) withdraw, except garrisons of own objectives and, with fortified_hold, of cities and fortified areas.

transfer._comment: R-AI-01 «сектора», R-MOVE-05 (step 7): a free reserve goes by road to the sector whose threat exceeds its forces.

position._comment: Step 7 item 6: position terms of the hex score (weights for the tournament, ± seeded jitter per game and side): w_cut — tanks and mechs on enemy supply paths (was pockets.dependency_weight); w_pocket — contact with enemy units at supply 0; w_risk — own steps in hexes a threatened own chokepoint would cut; w_choke — a ground unit on an own chokepoint.

retreat._comment: R-AI-01 «Отход» (designer decision 2026-11-27): a unit compares holding its hex with the VP for taking its steps out through an open exit (path, phases, risk of a cut on the way); rearguards near the withdrawal ways get a share of the exit VP they cover.
